{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check unique sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print(f'Unique sites: {unique_sites}')

# Check response rate by site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print(f'\nResponse rates by site:\n{response_rates}')

# Find site with highest response rate
highest_site = response_rates.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rates.max()

print(f'\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate:.3f})')"}
